why: For a long quote the span must run from the HEAD match's start to the TAIL match's end — match boundaries, never whole paragraphs, or a fragment rewrite over-replaces. The target is 293 chars (over the 200-char findClauseRange bail), so the full string can never be searched in one shot and genuine head+tail bridging (progressively-shortened head candidate, tail candidate, expandTo) is exercised: verified by spying on body.search against the real, unmodified word.ts (2 queries: one ~200-char head slice, one tail slice) and by mutation-testing a scratch copy with the bridging step deleted, which returns only the head slice and fails this case. CLAUDE.md findClauseRange head+tail gotcha.
